statement.task: Literal battery — bidirectional def<->use coverage. Forward: a literal recurring N times with no named constant/enum is a missing-def (classic magic-literal smell). Inverse: a defined constant/enum/member never referenced is a dead-def. Agentic code shows the inverse (mints defs, never uses them) more than human code. Relates to orphans. Seed signal of the battery.
statement.source_note: magic_literals kept pending complementary signals (user decision)
